name: Passkey Sign-In
summary: A returning user identifies the account by email, chooses passkey authentication, completes the platform passkey ceremony, and reaches the application home view.
finalOutcome: The email-resolved durable user has an authenticated session established through a valid user-verified passkey assertion.

sourceReferences.note: The user-bound passkey manager owns challenge validation, credential ownership checks, WebAuthn assertion verification, user verification policy, and signature-counter advancement.
Passkey Sign In resolves the entered email to the expected durable UserId and delegates to the same user-bound passkey proof used for step-up authentication.
The server exposes email-bound begin, browser-session complete, and mobile-token complete operations.
Angular Web now uses the retained email with the email-bound passkey operations and the browser WebAuthn ceremony.
React Native now performs the native passkey ceremony and completes the email-bound proof into the existing token-session lifecycle.
Generated AuthClient contracts expose typed email-bound passkey begin, browser complete, and mobile token complete methods.

Direct Passkey-first discovery is deferred from launch scope. Email-first primary Passkey and Password-then-Passkey MFA share one user-bound passkey proof primitive; the surrounding authentication state determines how successful proof is consumed.
Both canonical Passkey Sign-In scenarios are implementation-complete by source inspection. Browser and native runtime execution have not yet been performed, so authored tests remain not-started.
